name: Kitbitz · Chestnut Tree

title.zh: Kitbitz · 先看插画网格再选单个场景物件

description.zh: 看Chestnut Tree原素材大图与归属信息。 Kitbitz是按主题Kit组织的插画素材库，提供各素材可用的SVG或PNG入口，并有Figma套件等使用途径。原插画文件以CC0免费供合规商用，平台、插件、MCP和文档程序另属专有，第三方权利仍需另核。
description.en: Kitbitz is a themed illustration library with SVG or PNG assets, Figma kits and other catalog interfaces. The original illustration files are dedicated under CC0 for reuse, including commercial work. Platform, plugin, MCP, metadata and documentation software remain proprietary, while third-party rights require separate consideration.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Kitbitz (https://kitbitz.art/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Chestnut Tree原素材大图与归属信息。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看紫色首屏的插画说明，再对照网格中完整可见的火烈鸟、雪屋、篷车和消防栓等物件，最后看Chestnut Tree的大图与Nature Kit归属。它适合挑选场景点缀，这次未操作下载、插件或MCP，站方素材总量也未逐个清点。CC0只覆盖原插画文件，不能套给网站和工具源码，商标、肖像与隐私等第三方权利仍须另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
